name: Youth Career Program
org: City of Newport News, Office of Workforce Development and Economic Mobility
what_you_do: Youth learn about careers. They do hands-on summer work at job sites in the city. It is about 25 hours a week from June to August.
who_can_apply: Newport News residents ages 16 to 17 and young adults ages 18 to 24. Under 18 needs a signed parent or guardian consent form.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program pages
duration: About 25 hours a week, June to August (from the employer page)
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 enrollment is closed. Student applications reopen on February 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the Youth - Apply for the Youth Career Program link on the city page. Finish the application steps.
notes: Not open to 14 and 15 year olds. The city page does not state the wage.
